 The eufy Robot Vacuum and Mop S1 Pro Omni is £599 at Amazon , which is 54% off the retailer’s own price of £1,299. 
 We haven’t tested this exact model, but the £700 saving off Amazon’s price is a lot to take off a self-emptying, self-washing robot vacuum and mop. 
 The deal ends on 30 November 2026 , so you’ll have time to decide.

 Is the eufy S1 Pro Omni a good deal at £599?
 Price now: £599 at Amazon, checked 12 November 2026 at 13:50.
 Amazon’s reference price: £1,299, so the deal is 54% off.
 Amazon lists the deal as ending on 30 November 2026.
 This is a comparison against Amazon’s own reference price of £1,299, not a price quoted by another retailer.
 Advertisement 
 The eufy model comes in at £599, which makes it £700 cheaper than Amazon’s price, a 54% reduction.
 We don’t have any pricing from other UK retailers for this model, so we can’t say for sure whether it’s cheaper or pricier elsewhere. We checked the price at Amazon at 13:50 on 12 November 2026, and it’s not marked as a Prime-only deal.
 A 54% reduction against a reference price is a large one, but it’s worth remembering that a reference price tells you what the deal is being compared with at Amazon, not what shoppers have typically paid for this item.
 If you’re looking for more offers during the sale, keep an eye on our Amazon early Black Friday deals live blog .
 Should you buy it?
 This deal is a good fit if you’re after a robot vacuum and mop that has a self-emptying, self-washing dock and are willing to buy a model we haven’t tested on the strength of the £700 saving against Amazon’s reference price. If you want to get in on this deal before it ends on 30 November 2026, then this is a good fit for you.
 eufy S1 Pro Omni deal: your questions answered
 How much is the eufy Robot Vacuum and Mop S1 Pro Omni at Amazon? It is £599 at Amazon, checked on 12 November 2026 at 13:50. Amazon’s reference price is £1,299, so the deal is 54% off, a saving of £700.
 Have you tested the eufy S1 Pro Omni? No, we have not tested this exact model. We have reviewed a related model, the Eufy Robot Vacuum Omni E35, which scored 4 out of 5 from David Ludlow, but that is a different product.
 When does the Amazon deal on the eufy S1 Pro Omni end? Amazon lists the deal as ending on 30 November 2026. The price can change, so check the listing before you buy.
 Do I need Amazon Prime to get this price? No. The deal is not marked as Prime-only in the information we have, so the £599 price is not restricted to Prime members.
